retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-102 platform, 21 RSS traces for --help, --version, and doctor read-only, each with rssProtocol retained raw samples and derived steady/peak. Sampling is of the spawned measurement process T only, not the job VM. Linux: /proc/T/status VmRSS. macOS: task_info(T, TASK_VM_INFO) resident_size. Sample every 10 ms. peak = max sample. steady = median of samples at or after 20 ms. Fixtures are unauthored. This occupancy does not invent a binary-MB byte constant as a pass/fail bound.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Sampling follows rssProtocol. --help/--version use the same cold/warm pairing as G03. doctor read-only is one launch per sample, no warm pair. analyze and consented-probe RSS are not scored. Bound comparison waits on a D-006 unit successor. Every accepted sample must be compared against the D-006 bound after that unit exists, not only a percentile.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: D-102 fleet-class RSS corpus. Not authored.
